asserts: DRAGON (DeepSeek divergence #6). Disposal begun while apply is still running must await apply, then clean up everything apply collected — INCLUDING effects created after the dispose request arrived. It must not pass through ACTIVE, abandon partial effects, or run cleanup concurrently with the rest of apply.
regression_note: Amended 2026-08-24: the original form could not fail. e2 is created after the delay, so a runtime that tears down concurrently either misses e2 or rejects it as UNLOADING — either way the trace differs.
